parameters.jsCode:
const draft = $json.draft || '';
const subject = ($json.subject || '').replace(/'/g, "''");
const sender = $json.sender || '';
const threadId = $('Persist Incoming Email').item.json.thread_id;
const messageId = $('Persist Incoming Email').item.json.message_id;
const toAddresses = JSON.stringify([sender]);

const query =
  "WITH d AS (" +
  "INSERT INTO email_drafts " +
  "(thread_id, reply_to_message_id, current_body, original_ai_body, to_addresses, subject, revision, source_message_version, status) " +
  "VALUES ('" + threadId + "'::uuid, '" + messageId + "'::uuid, " +
  "$body$" + draft + "$body$, $body$" + draft + "$body$, " +
  "'" + toAddresses + "'::jsonb, '" + subject + "', 1, 1, 'editing') " +
  "ON CONFLICT (thread_id) WHERE status <> 'sent' DO UPDATE SET " +
  "current_body = EXCLUDED.current_body, " +
  "original_ai_body = EXCLUDED.original_ai_body, " +
  "subject = EXCLUDED.subject, " +
  "to_addresses = EXCLUDED.to_addresses, " +
  "reply_to_message_id = EXCLUDED.reply_to_message_id, " +
  "revision = email_drafts.revision + 1, " +
  "status = 'editing', " +
  "updated_at = now() " +
  "RETURNING id, revision" +
  "), rev AS (" +
  "INSERT INTO email_draft_revisions " +
  "(draft_id, revision, body, to_addresses, subject, actor) " +
  "SELECT id, revision, $body$" + draft + "$body$, " +
  "'" + toAddresses + "'::jsonb, '" + subject + "', 'ai' FROM d RETURNING id" +
  ") " +
  "SELECT (SELECT id FROM d) AS draft_id, " +
  "(SELECT revision FROM d) AS revision, " +
  "(SELECT id FROM rev) AS revision_id;";

return [{ json: { query } }];

options.systemMessage: You are an email assistant for the business owner. Draft concise, professional, friendly email replies. Always call the knowledge_base tool first to ground your answer in company information. When CRM customer context is provided, ground the reply in the customer's real contacts, sites, equipment, purchases and service history, and reference their equipment names or serial numbers when relevant. If the knowledge base has no relevant answer, say what you can and keep the reply honest. Output ONLY the reply body text, no subject line, no commentary, no sign-off placeholder brackets.

WITH sender AS (SELECT lower($1) AS email),
matches AS (
  SELECT cu.id, cu.name, cu.email, 'customer' AS via
  FROM crm_customers cu, sender
  WHERE cu.email <> '' AND lower(cu.email) = sender.email
  UNION
  SELECT cu.id, cu.name, cu.email, 'contact' AS via
  FROM crm_contacts ct
  JOIN crm_customers cu ON cu.id = ct.customer_id, sender
  WHERE ct.email <> '' AND lower(ct.email) = sender.email
)
SELECT (SELECT count(DISTINCT id) FROM matches) AS match_count,
       (SELECT jsonb_build_object('id', id, 'name', name, 'email', email, 'via', via) FROM matches LIMIT 1) AS customer;

WITH mb AS (
  INSERT INTO email_mailboxes (provider, address)
  VALUES ('microsoft', $1)
  ON CONFLICT (provider, address) DO UPDATE SET address = EXCLUDED.address
  RETURNING id
),
th AS (
  INSERT INTO email_threads (mailbox_id, provider_thread_key, subject, status, last_message_at)
  SELECT id, $2, COALESCE(NULLIF($3, ''), '(no subject)'), 'needs_attention', $4::timestamptz FROM mb
  ON CONFLICT (mailbox_id, provider_thread_key) DO UPDATE
    SET last_message_at = GREATEST(email_threads.last_message_at, EXCLUDED.last_message_at),
        subject = COALESCE(NULLIF(EXCLUDED.subject, ''), email_threads.subject),
        updated_at = now()
  RETURNING id, mailbox_id
),
msg AS (
  INSERT INTO email_messages (thread_id, mailbox_id, provider_key, provider_ref, internet_message_id, direction, sender, to_addresses, subject, body_text, occurred_at)
  SELECT th.id, th.mailbox_id, $5, $5, $6, 'incoming', $7, $8::jsonb, COALESCE(NULLIF($3, ''), '(no subject)'), $9, $4::timestamptz FROM th
  ON CONFLICT (mailbox_id, provider_key) DO UPDATE
    SET body_text = COALESCE(NULLIF(EXCLUDED.body_text, ''), email_messages.body_text)
  RETURNING id
)
SELECT (SELECT id FROM mb) AS mailbox_id, (SELECT id FROM th) AS thread_id, (SELECT id FROM msg) AS message_id;

parameters.query:
WITH x AS (
  SELECT t.id AS thread_id
  FROM email_mailboxes mb
  JOIN email_threads t ON t.mailbox_id = mb.id
  WHERE mb.provider = 'microsoft' AND mb.address = $1 AND t.provider_thread_key = $2
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT (SELECT thread_id FROM x) AS thread_id,
  (SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('provider_key', m.provider_key, 'sender', m.sender, 'body_text', m.body_text, 'occurred_at', m.occurred_at) ORDER BY m.occurred_at)
   FROM email_messages m, x WHERE m.thread_id = x.thread_id) AS messages;
